overall_reason: The revenue card's chart arrives as a whole-block fade (one 600 ms opacity transition on the browser's default ease; the recorder sees no geometry change), holds for about two seconds, then disappears so the card sits empty at 4016 ms before the chart returns by 5504 ms.

score.reason: T-POSTER passes for the held chart, but T-DEMO-LOOP fails because the reset empties the card with no cause, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds the payoff on the browser's default ease.

findings.where: passive recording, the revenue chart reset, 1440
findings.evidence: The chart is full at 1610 and 2610 ms, gone at 4016 ms with only 'Revenue, 14 days' and '$68,200' left on a blank card, and back at 5504 ms; nothing in frame causes the reset.
findings.before: The chart vanishes and the card sits empty mid-loop.
findings.after: Make the reset invisible (swap the data while the card is hidden) or bring the next period's chart in as new data, and start the next loop within about 1 s.
findings.why: An empty card under a revenue figure reads as missing data, not as a loop.

findings.evidence: The chart declares one 600 ms opacity transition on 'ease' (browser default), and the passive recorder reports no movement: the line and fill appear together as a block between the 912 and 1610 ms stills.
findings.before: The whole chart fades in on the browser's default curve.
findings.after: Draw the line left to right on a storytelling curve and let the fill follow it, so the arrival tells the trend; keep a fade only for the end dot.
findings.why: A fade shows that a chart exists but not that revenue rose, which is the card's one point.

strengths: The chart holds full from at least 1610 to 2610 ms, and the poster frame (fold-1440.png) shows the finished chart.
not_investigated: how the chart's clip rect is used during the arrival: no still falls inside the 600 ms fade
no click runs: the capture skipped click motion (--no-motion), so the sweep's MOT-002 measured limits are not verified and no trigger rows exist
the passive stills are 7 frames over 6 s (about 0, 400, 900, 1600, 2600, 4000 and 5500 ms); in-between frames, exact curves and the loop seam timing cannot be seen
interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built
hover as it plays, gestures, scroll-driven motion and route transitions: not captured
the 8 MOT-001 motion_css hits come from the shared stylesheet every item loads (.ss-bubble, .ss-receipt, .ss-roll__mid and others), not from this composition; they are left to the sweep
